global.criterion: Compact clearly sculpted 3D cartoon educational miniature on warm off-white, credible material textures, no photoreal full scene or toy-faced character; coherent with S1-01 accepted pilot.
No words, numerals, printed card lines, arrows, symbols, labels, logos, brand-like emblems, watermark or pseudo-writing anywhere.

No real or rendered person, face, helper, hands, detached body part, real injury, chemical release or treatment. A synthetic full faceless display mannequin is allowed only in the two scenes that request one.

s102-video-dizzy-case.criterion: Synthetic full training mannequin is seated safely under nearby shade, not expected to walk to a distant vehicle; props are still and unused.
Moisture beads are plausible on the mannequin, without any graphic inference that stopped sweating is required or that a diagnosis has been proven.
Fan, cloths and blank phone are visible, but no oral drink, medicine, helper or performed care is depicted.
A worked-case composition in elevated field shelter differs from the previously accepted single eye-level heat-reading tableau.

s102-video-ankle-case.criterion: Concealed shallow hole and a continuous boundary are clear, with a safe approach route away from the edge.
Clearly synthetic full faceless mannequin rests supported beside the hole, with ankle left in the found position; no lifting or limb manipulation.
No blood, real injury, fracture assertion or visible helper; blank call card is only a prop.

s102-video-eye-case.criterion: Full dual-nozzle fixed eyewash station with visible pipe connection is separate from unopened plain training bottle; a small portable bottle is not the sole provision.
Safe unobstructed route between station and prop is readable at a different angle from the prior chemical-reading scene.
No actual discharge, eye, person, helper, running water or performed washing; no fixed duration is visually implied.

s102-video-kit-case.criterion: Clean unused gauze, tape, blanket, blank card and phone are distinguishable, with a closed background kit rather than a duplicate open-kit inventory.
Fixed plumbed full eyewash unit is separate and more substantial than a small sealed starter rinse bottle.
No care, person, body part, medicine or tweezers use; card and phone are truly blank.
